plan.notes: Des Moines Area Community College 2025-2026 catalog (catoid 28), Business: Transfer Major AA (designed for transfer to ISU, UNI, Iowa, Clarke, St. Ambrose, or Upper Iowa to study Business). Total 64 credits; semester sums match exactly. Option slots recorded at catalog minimum credits: Option 2 (MAT 141 4 / MAT 156 3) recorded as 3, Option 5 (BUS 231 4 / MAT 164 4 / MGT 101 3) recorded as 3. The 3-credit Diversity Requirement is satisfied within core courses and adds no credits. Transfer note: ISU-bound Accounting majors should use ACC 202 for the 1-credit elective. Course titles expand the catalog's standard abbreviations (Prin.=Principles, Busn=Business, Fund=Fundamentals, Decis=Decisions).
